mapper.select: SELECT mpdet.souce_code souceCode, mpdet.souce_type souceType, mpdet.souce_value souceValue, mpdet.dict_code dictCode, mpdet.f_det_id fDetId, mpdet.lev , mpdet.dict_code||'-'||mpdet.souce_value detId FROM (SELECT mapping_id,souce_code,souce_type,souce_value,dict_code,f_det_id,"LEVEL" lev FROM STT_MAPPING_DET) mpdet INNER JOIN stt_mapping mp ON mpdet.mapping_id = mp.mapping_id WHERE mp.TGT_VALUE=#{tgtValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT listagg(dict_code||'-'||item_code,',')within group(order by linked_item_code) child, linked_dict_code pDictCode, trim(linked_item_code) pId FROM sys_datadict_list_link where 1=1 AND dict_code=#{dictCode} GROUP BY linked_item_code,linked_dict_code
SELECT mapping_id mappingId, remark remark FROM STT_MAPPING WHERE 1=1 AND DICT_CODE = #{dictCode} AND TGT_VALUE = #{tgtValue}
